schema.name: agent_name
schema.description: Observed agent; the first part of the key, as on the manifest.

schema.name: trajectory_id
schema.description: The conversation this turn belongs to, joining to trajectory_payloads on (agent_name, trajectory_id).

schema.name: turn_index
schema.description: ConversationTurn.turn_index: the key's third part, and the order a reader reassembles the conversation in. Per turn rather than per trace, because the big_query source carries no trace ids while every source has a turn index.

schema.name: created_at
schema.description: When this copy was stored. Partition column, matching the manifest's so the two expire together.

schema.name: turn
schema.description: One ConversationTurn, as a JSON object rather than as JSON text -- so `turn.events[0].author` reads in SQL, which is most of what an evidence store is for.
